pages.title: Golconda Fort
pages.extract: Golconda Fort is a fortified citadel and an early capital city of the Qutb Shahi dynasty. It is located in Hyderabad, Telangana. Built of granite, it is known for its acoustics.

pages.title: Bala Hissar Gate
pages.extract: Bala Hissar Gate is the main entrance to the upper citadel. Its carved arch faces east.

pages.title: Fateh Darwaza
pages.extract: Fateh Darwaza is the Victory Gate of the fort. It is known for its clap acoustics.
